description: Get a provider's Wise payout state: whether Wise payouts are enabled on the platform, the masked destination hint and target currency, whether the post-change cool-off is still active, queued earnings waiting for the next batch, the minimum payout threshold, and the latest batch payout status. Use when a provider asks about Wise payouts, why their Wise earnings are still queued, or when a newly linked Wise destination will become payable. Wise recipient identifiers and fingerprints are deliberately not returned. Read-only and free; the provider_id comes from list_providers.

provider_id.description: From list_providers, or the caller's own

name: get_wise_status
